recipe.visualDefinition: A full-body portrait of a man with surreal, exaggeratedly large hands and a thin torso, set against a stark, flat white background. The subject wears vibrant red leather trousers and a matching red cap, contrasted by a massive, thick gold rope chain.
coreVisualRelationships: Extreme scale contrast between the oversized hands and the slender torso
Vibrant red clothing against a clinical, high-key white void
Heavy, textured gold jewelry juxtaposed with smooth skin and leather
Direct, wide-eyed facial expression creating a sense of absurdist confrontation
coreInvariants: High-contrast color palette of red, gold, and white
Complete absence of environmental context or shadows

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centrally aligned, vertical orientation, occupying approximately 80% of the vertical frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The oversized fists at the hips, which create a wide, stable base for the upper body.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the wide-eyed face, moves down the gold chain to the torso, and terminates at the massive, clenched fists.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive, uniform white negative space surrounding the figure to emphasize the silhouette.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Pure white background for isolation and high-key lighting.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Saturated primary red for the trousers and headwear.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Metallic yellow-gold for the oversized rope chain and rings.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the clothing and jewelry against a zero-saturation background.

letterConstructionRules: Slightly arched following the curve of the cap
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface used for utility; focus remains on the visual distortion.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the bold, condensed, high-visibility look on the cap.
Provides a clean, professional alternative with similar proportions.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a full-body portrait of a thin man with surrealistically large hands, wearing red leather pants and a red baseball cap, with a massive gold rope chain, isolated on a pure white background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply bold white sans-serif uppercase text to the front of the cap, following the curve of the brim.

verificationChecks: Are the hands significantly larger than the head?
Is the background pure white with no horizon line?
Is the red of the pants and cap consistent in hue?
Is the gold chain rendered with high-contrast highlights?

mustRedesign: Exact facial features of the individual
Specific text content on the cap

mustAchieve: Clean, sharp edges on the silhouette
Realistic skin and leather textures despite surreal proportions
High-key lighting with minimal soft shadows
avoid: Visible digital artifacts in the scaling of the hands

postGenerationChecks: Check for anatomical consistency in the distorted areas.
Ensure the gold chain has a metallic luster.
Verify the white background is 100% desaturated.
Confirm the text on the cap follows the 3D form of the fabric.
recipe.reuseFormula: Surrealist anatomical distortion + High-key isolation + Primary color blocking + Exaggerated luxury accessories.
